hypothesis.question: How does the already-supported NS upstream speech_probability create its stateful VAD effect under nonstationary noise?
hypothesis.shipping_lane: exact shipping guard plus blend behavior
hypothesis.no_upstream_evidence_lane: same NS-assisted 0.35 decision/hold semantics but no upstream guard and no upstream blend
hypothesis.blend_only_lane: same constants and state machine with upstream blend enabled but upstream guard disabled
hypothesis.guard_only_lane: same constants and state machine with upstream guard enabled but upstream blend disabled
hypothesis.interpretation: The lanes are causal ablations of existing shipping consumption paths, not candidate mappings. Their recall/FPR, probability AUC and frame-attribution differences are diagnostic only.

decision_contract.VAD_UPSTREAM_CONSUMPTION_DECOMPOSED_REVI: Exact shipping mirror identity holds and fresh nonstationary data exercise a stateful difference between shipping and the same-threshold no-upstream-evidence lane.
decision_contract.NO_VAD_UPSTREAM_CONSUMPTION_EFFECT_REVIE: Mirror identity holds but fresh nonstationary data do not exercise a shipping-versus-no-upstream stateful difference.
decision_contract.VAD_UPSTREAM_CONSUMPTION_INPUT_INVALID_R: Exact source/seed binding, finite-value, geometry, or shipping mirror identity preconditions fail.

next_review: Review causal attribution only. Any source candidate, guard/blend change or threshold/mapping change requires a separate preregistered hypothesis and entirely new authority.
